<script type="text/javascript">
    var makeUserInfo = function (resp) {
        var userInfo = {};
        //userInfo.name = resp.Model.Email;
        userInfo.isLogin = resp.Success;
        return userInfo;
    }

    $.ajax({
        url: '/User/Account/GetUserLoginInfo?v=' + Math.random()
        , data: {}
        , cache: false
        , type: 'post'
        , success: function (resp) {
            //配置用户基本信息
            var userInfo = makeUserInfo(resp);
            var loginView = $(".login-hearder .isLogin");
            var unLoginView = $(".login-hearder .unLogin");
            if (userInfo.isLogin) {
                loginView.show()
            }
            else {
                unLoginView.show()
            }

        }//success
        , error: function () {
            throw new Error('ERROR: get user info')
        }
    });//ajax
</script>
<script>
   // 初始化来也机器人
    function initLaiye(){
        var aiScript = document.createElement('script');
        aiScript.type = 'text/javascript';
        aiScript.src = 'https://cdn.wul.ai/IMLib-3.30.0.min.js';
        document.body.insertBefore(aiScript, document.body.firstChild);
        aiScript.onload = function () {
            // 需要在这里写ajax异步操作，不然它可能在没加载之前调用然后报错
            $.ajax({
                url: '/User/Account/GetWulPubKey'
                , type: 'get'
                , success: function (resp) {
                    // 获取来也机器人信息
                    var isOpen = resp.Data.IsOpen;
                    if (isOpen) {
                        var key = resp.Data.PubKey;
                        new websdk({
                            data: {
                                pubkey: key, // 吾来平台PubKey
                                autoOpen: false, // 是否自动打开
                                extra: {
                                    tagValues: [],
                                    presetTagValues: []
                                }
                            },
                            el: 'body'
                        })
                    }
                }
            })
        }
    }
    
    // 初始化天润机器
    function initTianrun(robotKey){
        (function(win, doc, src, opt) {
            win[opt] = win[opt] || function () {
            win[opt].options = arguments[0]};
            var script = doc.createElement("script");
            script.async = 1;
            script.src = src;
            doc.body.appendChild(script);
            })(window, document, "https://webchat-sh.clink.cn/webchat.js?v="+Date.now(), "clinkWebchatOptions");
        clinkWebchatOptions({
            accessId: robotKey,
            language: "zh_CN"
        });
    }

    // 获取天润机器人灰度
    $.ajax({
            url: '/User/Account/GetPortalAIRobot'
            , type: 'get'
            , success: function (resp) {
                if (resp.Data.IsOpen && resp.Data.PubKey) {
                    initTianrun(resp.Data.PubKey)
                }else{
                    initLaiye();
                }
            }
        })
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    function GetParam(key) {
        return (document.location.search.match(new RegExp("(?:^\\?|&)" + key + "=(.*?)(?=&|$)")) || ['', null])[1];
    }

    function myHTMLEnCode(str) {
        var s = "";
        if (str.length == 0) return "";
        s = str.replace(/&/g, "&amp;");
        s = s.replace(/</g, "&lt;");
        s = s.replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
        s = s.replace(/ /g, "&nbsp;");
        s = s.replace(/\'/g, "&#39;");
        s = s.replace(/\"/g, "&quot;");
        s = s.replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
        return s;
    }

    function myHTMLDeCode(str) {
        var s = "";
        if (str.length == 0) return "";
        s = str.replace(/&amp;/g, "&");
        s = s.replace(/&lt;/g, "<");
        s = s.replace(/&gt;/g, ">");
        s = s.replace(/&nbsp;/g, " ");
        s = s.replace(/&#39;/g, "\'");
        s = s.replace(/&quot;/g, "\"");
        s = s.replace(/<br>/g, "\n");
        return s;
    }

    var defaultText = "请输入职位关键字";

    $(document).ready(function () {
        $("input[name='keyword']").click(function () {
            $(this).val("");
        });

        var keyWord = GetParam("k");

        if (keyWord != null) {
            keyWord = decodeURIComponent(keyWord);
            keyWord = myHTMLDeCode(keyWord);

            $("input[name='k']").val(keyWord);
        }

        $("#searchlink").click(function () {
            var r = GetParam("r");
            r = (r == null ? -1 : r);
            var p = GetParam("p");
            p = (p == null ? "" : p);
            var c = GetParam("c");
            c = (c == null ? "" : c);
            var d = GetParam("d");
            d = (d == null ? "" : d);
            var k = $.trim($("input[name='k']").val());

            if (k == defaultText)
                k = "";

            k = myHTMLEnCode(k);
            k = encodeURIComponent($.trim(k));

            location.href = "/campus" + "?r=" + r + "&p=" + p + "&c=" + c + "&d=" + d + "&k=" + k + '#jlt';
        });

        var keyStr = $("#k").val();
        if (!keyStr || keyStr == "") {
            $("#k").css("color", "#d2cece");
            $("#k").val(defaultText);
        }

        $("#k").focus(function () {
            var v = $(this).val();
            if (v == defaultText) {
                $(this).val("");
                $(this).css("color", "");
            }
        });

        $("#k").blur(function () {
            var v = $(this).val();
            if (!v || v == "") {
                $(this).val(defaultText);
                $(this).css("color", "#d2cece");
            }
        });
        //搜索区折叠处理
        // 超过三行 折叠显示更多
        $.each($('.mainList'), function (i, n) {
            if ($(this).height() > 90) {
                $(this).addClass('more');
                $(this).next('.viewMore').show();
            }
        })
        $('.viewMore').click(function (e) {
            var target = $(e.currentTarget)
            if (target.text() == "更多") {
                target.text('收起')
                target.prev('.mainList').removeClass('more')
            } else {
                target.text('更多')
                target.prev('.mainList').addClass('more')
            }

        })
    });
</script>


    </div>
